_comment: English lettering of 3eng.jpg keyed by the OCR block text of 3jp.jpg; bootstrapped by demo/typeset_reference.py from OCR of the reference page and then corrected by hand from the demo/output/reference/3jp review sheets. Blocks left empty keep the machine translation.
爺ちゃんにじゃねえよ買ってんだ: They're not for you. They're for the nurses.
花とかもいちいち買ってん貯金しろ: Don't be buying flowers all the time. Save your money.
こんな消毒くせえサボッてんじゃ: Don't go wasting your time at a sad place like this.
部活はどうしたよ: Hey, what about your school club?
尚更だ馬鹿: Even more so then, you idiot!
いちいち見舞いなんて: I wouldn't come here so often if I wasn't so bored!
うるせえなあ部活は５時前に終わんの！: That's enough! My club finishes before five!
手のく範囲でいい: It doesn't have to be all the time.
迷っても: You may feel lost. Don't expect gratitude.
